findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "http" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: spend_guard_check_purchase, spend_guard_record_purchase, spend_guard_set_rules, spend_guard_report · Private data: spend_guard_check_purchase, spend_guard_record_purchase, spend_guard_set_rules, spend_guard_report · Public sink: spend_guard_check_purchase, spend_guard_record_purchase, spend_guard_set_rules, spend_guard_report · Destructive: spend_guard_check_purchase, spend_guard_record_purchase, spend_guard_set_rules, spend_guard_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: spend_guard_check_purchase, spend_guard_record_purchase, spend_guard_set_rules, spend_guard_report · Private data: spend_guard_check_purchase, spend_guard_record_purchase, spend_guard_set_rules, spend_guard_report · Public sink: spend_guard_check_purchase, spend_guard_record_purchase, spend_guard_set_rules, spend_guard_report · Destructive: spend_guard_check_purchase, spend_guard_record_purchase, spend_guard_set_rules, spend_guard_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
